courses.title: Data Pipeline Architecture at Scale
courses.description: Data Pipeline Architecture at Scale takes you from the basics of data pipeline architecture to applying it on a realistic Data Engineering Lead scenario, through short lessons and hands-on practice. Along the way, you'll also get a practical introduction to data governance, enough to use it alongside data pipeline architecture day to day. Expect a practical course, not a lecture-heavy one.
learning_outcomes: Applying data pipeline architecture to a real Data Engineering Lead scenario
Practicing data pipeline architecture through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to data governance
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in etl design and want to go further.
